_help: SIM and internet offers shown on sim-internet.html. Updated weekly by a scheduled Claude task that reads each company's official website. Every plan must come from the company's own site: name, price (number, as shown by the company), currency, data, calls, validity, kind (prepaid|postpaid|data|home|esim), url (the official page it was read from), note (e.g. 'incl. VAT'). checked_at: UTC time the company's site was last checked. Never estimate a price. affiliate_url: only a real referral link the Manager has received from that company's programme.
